hero.title: Ask Claude for a CV. Get a page you can check, version and send.
hero.lead: Each CV is a standalone HTML document on a fixed template. Claude edits it over MCP, you watch it change live, and every PDF is compared with the page before you download it.
hero.allowList: Sign-in is limited to an allow-list of GitHub accounts for now.

ledger.caption: A CV and its revisions
ledger.prompt: Tailor my angular-senior CV to this vacancy and keep it on one page.
ledger.rev9: Summary and skills rewritten for the vacancy

mcp.title: Claude does the writing, in the client you already use
mcp.client: Connect claude.ai or Claude Code once. The app never calls a model itself: there is no AI key to set up here and no editor to learn.
mcp.rules: Each template comes with rules Claude reads first, and every write is validated against them, so a CV cannot drift from its design.

tools.readTemplate: Learn a template's classes and page limits
tools.create: Start a CV on a template
tools.read: Open the current or any earlier revision
tools.write: Save a change as a new revision

pdf.checksTitle: Before the PDF is yours, the app compares it with the page

checks.words: Every word is in the PDF text layer
checks.order: Blocks read in the same order

pdf.report: If something is off, you get a report instead of the file, and can still download it anyway.
pdf.title: No separate check to remember
pdf.text: It runs on every export. It does not promise that an ATS will accept the file; it promises the file says what the page says.

landing.next: An applications tracker where each entry points to the exact revision you sent, a master file Claude writes every CV from, and cover letters exported as PDF.
